title: Exponents
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

sections.title: What a power means
sections.objective: Evaluate a power by multiplying the base by itself.
explain: Any number to the power 1 is itself: 9¹ = 9. Any number except 0 to the power 0 is 1: 7⁰ = 1.
sections.key: An exponent says how many times to multiply the base by itself. 2⁴ is 2 × 2 × 2 × 2, not 2 × 4.
sections.workedCaption: Follow the pattern down to the power 0.

sections.title: Negative bases
explain: Odd powers of a negative base stay negative: (−2)³ = −8.
sections.key: Check what the base is. (−3)² squares −3; −3² squares only the 3, then puts the minus in front.

sections.title: Powers in the order of operations
sections.objective: Do powers after parentheses and before multiplying, dividing, adding and subtracting.
explain: (2 + 3)² is not 2² + 3²: the power applies to the whole result in the parentheses.
sections.key: Powers come right after parentheses: parentheses, powers, × and ÷, + and −.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.objective: Powers on their own, with negative bases, and inside expressions.
sections.key: A power multiplies the base by itself. Check what the base is, and do powers right after parentheses.

hints.alg.exponents.evaluate: Write the base out as many times as the exponent says, and multiply. To the power 0 is 1.
hints.alg.exponents.negative-base: Is the minus sign inside the parentheses with the number? If so, it's part of the base. If not, do the power first, then make it negative.
hints.alg.exponents.in-order: Parentheses first, then powers, then × and ÷, then + and −.
hints.alg.exponents: Find the base, multiply it by itself, and keep the order: parentheses, powers, × and ÷, + and −.

misconceptionMessages.alg.exp-times: The exponent isn't something to multiply by. It says how many times to multiply the base by itself: 2⁴ = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2.
misconceptionMessages.alg.exp-zero: Any number (except 0) to the power 0 is 1. Follow the pattern: 2³ = 8, 2² = 4, 2¹ = 2, 2⁰ = 1.
misconceptionMessages.alg.exp-negative-base: Check the sign. With parentheses, (−3)² = (−3) × (−3) is positive. Without them, −3² means −(3 × 3), which is negative.
misconceptionMessages.alg.exp-power-last: Powers come before multiplying, dividing, adding and subtracting. Do the power first.
misconceptionMessages.alg.exp-each-term: Work out the parentheses first, then apply the power to that one number: (2 + 3)² = 5² = 25.
